$schema-note: Hand-maintained. Data, not code: nothing under src/ imports this file.
purpose: The guard ledger for WIN-260 (M2.5) — the typed configuration sections and
the gate that keeps feature code out of the ambient environment. One entry
per refusal, carrying the file it lives in (repo-relative), the EXACT text
that implements it (`from`), the edit that removes it (`to`), the suites
run, and the NAMED cases that were SEEN to go red (`kills`).
A guard nothing can turn red is a guard that is not there. Every entry
below was exercised before this dimension was proposed.
ONE LEDGER, TWO HOMES, and the reason is that they are one dimension's
guards and one sweep. The configuration sections live under
apps/core-api/src/config/ and the containment gate that pins their single
environment read lives in scripts/arch/. Splitting them would mean two
ledgers whose entries only make sense read together: the gate's whole
subject is the reader those sections depend on, and two of the entries
below mutate a WIRING line in a main.ts and are killed by the GATE rather
than by any suite in the package that holds them.
`file` is therefore REPOSITORY-relative, not package-relative. Every other
ledger in this tree is package-relative because every other ledger has one
home; saying `src/config/platform.ts` here would be a path that resolves
in one of the two homes and not the other.
This lives here rather than in README.md because that file is emitted by
scripts/arch/gen-v1-skeleton.mjs and byte-compared by `node
scripts/arch/gen-v1-skeleton.mjs --check`.
procedure: PROVE THE SUITES GREEN FIRST. The driver runs each suite set UNMUTATED and
refuses to sweep unless it is green, and classifies a module-load failure
with no named failing case as VACUOUS rather than as a kill. WIN-258's
tranche 1 reported 22 kills that were every one of them vacuous, because
the package's dist/ had been cleaned and every suite failed to LOAD.
For one entry: replace its `from` with its `to` in the named file, run the
suites it names, and confirm a NAMED case goes red. Then revert and
vitest   pnpm --filter @platos/core-api exec vitest run src/config
NONE of these entries needs a database, a container or a network. Every
guard here is a decision about a string, taken before anything is
constructed, which is the whole point of validating at startup.
